topics.quote: Twice each day the tide lifts the moored boats by four meters.
The signal tower uses seven colored flags to describe the weather.
In winter the boats are hauled onto timber cradles along the north shore.
Café owners on the quay open their shutters at the first bell.
Every pear tree in the orchard was planted in early spring.
Pruning happens in late winter while the branches are bare.
The harvest begins when the first pear falls without being touched.
